title: ErrorEnvelope
description: Body of every non-2xx response. Clients branch on `code`; an unrecognized code is treated as its HTTP status class. Unknown properties are ignored.

code.description: Stable machine code. Shared codes are listed in `examples`; products may add their own, documented in their OpenAPI.

message.description: Human-readable. Never contains tokens, credentials or protected data.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Set with `rate_limited` or `unavailable` when retrying later is safe.
